description: Defra annual supply balances shown as national context for the Food Origins baskets (Stage 5, LP-05; John, 25 Oct 2026; the other eleven baskets 26 Oct 2026). Values are read as published; the build checks that total supply = production + imports - exports and that the share = production / total supply. Never combined with HMRC monthly trade (spec SS-07).

Defra's trade figures are fresh, chilled and frozen meat without offal (notes 7 and 14), and leave out the large trade in processed poultry; the Food Origins basket includes poultry offal.
